title: Ledger Investing Releases Mid-Year 2026 Reinsurance and ILS Report
summary: Ledger Investing releases its Mid-Year 2026 Reinsurance and ILS Report covering market trends, catastrophe bonds, capital markets, and casualty ILS.
body_markdown:
announcement


Ledger Investing Releases Mid-Year 2026 Reinsurance and ILS Report


Our[Mid-Year 2026 Reinsurance and ILS Report](https://www.ledgerinvesting.com/insurance-library?article=mid-year-reinsurance-and-ils-report) is now available!


Designed for insurers, MGAs, fronting carriers, reinsurers, and institutional investors, the report examines the forces shaping pricing, capacity, transaction activity, and capital formation across today's P&C reinsurance and capital markets landscape.


Inside, we explore:


-


Why abundant capital is accelerating the softening of the property-cat market


-


How record catastrophe bond issuance and compressing spreads are reshaping ILS markets


-


What the 2026 hurricane season outlook could mean for pricing and risk


-


Why growing investor interest is creating an early opportunity in casualty ILS


As property-cat spreads compress and investors seek diversifying, uncorrelated returns, alternative capital is increasingly looking beyond catastrophe risk.


[Download the report](https://www.ledgerinvesting.com/insurance-library?article=mid-year-reinsurance-and-ils-report) to better understand where the market stands today, where it may be heading next, and what these changes could mean for your business.
